figurative_meaning_bn: প্রায় শেষ হয়ে আসছে এমন সময়ে
figurative_meaning_en: At a time when something is nearly ending
example_sentences_in_english: Finally, he showed up just as it was ending.
We returned home towards the very end of the party.
note: This idiom is a reduplicative form emphasizing the final moments.
